formula: x = origin.x + (c - r) * tilePx / 2, y = origin.y + (c + r) * tilePx / 4, with c = col + 0.5 + maps[id].col, r = row + 0.5 + maps[id].row
labelNote: repo-only: maps[id].label = the tile where the Map menu writes the map's name (from the mockup; may lie past the map's edge)
palengkeNote: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): the Lumang Palengke sits west of the Slums (its east gate, col 279 rows 103-105, meets the Slums' west gate, col 0 rows 116-118), off the left of ui-map-world.png: until the picture has it, the Map menu draws a plain diamond there. posts.palengke: its four Lantern Posts (2x2; px at each one's middle).
